answer: A concrete defense is stake-backed identity. Each agent must lock verifiable collateral worth more than any profit a single fake account could extract, and its influence stays capped by a slowly earned track record. Forging ten thousand personas would then demand ten thousand funded stakes, turning a cheap tundra of invented names into real capital at risk. Like trees in a grove that must grow their own roots, new agents earn standing gradually instead of claiming it. The cost of deception climbs and the horizon of profitable sybils recedes.
